steps.say: A quadratic in a ratio factors like any other, so the equation is $[[factored]] = 0$.
The first factor needs $\sin x = [[r1]]$, which in one turn is reached at $[[s1]]$.
The second needs $\sin x = [[r2]]$, reached at $[[s2]]$.
Those are every angle from $0^{\circ}$ up to but not including $360^{\circ}$ that satisfies either factor, and together they are [[value]].

answer: So the equation has [[value]] [[noun]] in that interval.
